column1: Rear Gear\nBeefy landing gear that sport a wider stance and are intended to be used in the rear for jet airplanes.
column2: 后起落架\n粗壮的起落架，轮距更宽，专为喷气式飞机的后部设计。

column1: Wing Gear\nLanding gear specially made to attach to a wing. They are capable of retracting and snuggling up right under the wing.
column2: 翼式起落架\n专门安装在机翼上的起落架，可收起并紧贴机翼下方。

column1: Bare Wing Gear\nLanding gear specially made to attach to a wing with a custom cover. They are capable of retracting and snuggling up right under the wing.
column2: 裸翼式起落架\n专门安装在机翼上的起落架，带自定义整流罩，可收起并紧贴机翼下方。

column1: Fixed Gear\nUseful for taking off, and landing without destroying your airplane.
column2: 固定起落架\n便于起飞与着陆，而且不会让你的飞机散架。

column1: Short Gear\nFancy landing gear that can hide on command. This is great because it's one of the few animations in the game, and it reduces drag.
column2: 短起落架\n可按指令收起的讲究起落架。它是游戏里少数带动画的部件，还能降低阻力。

column1: Boom 50\n500-pound dumb bomb. It makes a bigger boom.
column2: 轰-50\n500 磅无制导炸弹，爆炸动静更大。

column1: Boom 25\nIt's a 250-pound dumb bomb. It goes boom when it hits something.
column2: 轰-25\n250 磅无制导炸弹，撞到东西就炸。

column1: Lazy 50\nThis is a laser-guided bomb with 500lbs of love.
column2: 懒-50\n500 磅的激光制导炸弹，满满都是心意。
